verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .

verses.original: דַּבְּרוּ֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֤י אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ יִהְיֶה֙ מִבְּשָׂר֔וֹ זָ֣ב זוֹב֖וֹ הֽוּא׃ טָמֵ֥א
verses.transliteration: dab·bə·rū ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wa·’ă·mar·tem ’ă·lê·hem kî ’îš ’îš yih·yeh mib·bə·śā·rōw zāḇ zō·w·ḇōw hū ṭā·mê
verses.literal: Say to the Israelites . . . - - When any man has a bodily discharge the discharge - is unclean

verses.original: וְזֹ֛את טֻמְאָת֖וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה בְּזוֹב֑וֹ בְּשָׂר֞וֹ אֶת־ רָ֣ר זוֹב֗וֹ אֽוֹ־ הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ הִֽוא׃ טֻמְאָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ ṭum·’ā·ṯōw tih·yeh bə·zō·w·ḇōw bə·śā·rōw ’eṯ- rār zō·w·ḇōw ’ōw- heḥ·tîm bə·śā·rōw miz·zō·w·ḇōw hî ṭum·’ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: This uncleanness is from his discharge whether his body - allows the discharge {to flow} or blocks it - So his discharge will bring about uncleanness

verses.original: כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ב עָלָ֛יו אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַזָּ֖ב יִשְׁכַּ֥ב יִטְמָ֑א וְכָֽל־ הַכְּלִ֛י עָלָ֖יו אֲשֶׁר־ יֵשֵׁ֥ב יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·miš·kāḇ ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer haz·zāḇ yiš·kaḇ yiṭ·mā wə·ḵāl hak·kə·lî ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer- yê·šêḇ yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies will be unclean and any furniture on which he sits will be unclean

verses.original: וְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִגַּ֖ע בְּמִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer yig·ga‘ bə·miš·kā·ḇōw yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַֽל־ הַכְּלִ֔י עָלָ֖יו אֲשֶׁר־ הַזָּ֑ב יֵשֵׁ֥ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yō·šêḇ ‘al- hak·kə·lî ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer- haz·zāḇ yê·šêḇ yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever sits on furniture on which the man with the discharge was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְהַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בִּבְשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·ḡê·a‘ biḇ·śar haz·zāḇ yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever touches the body of the man with a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ הַזָּ֖ב יָרֹ֛ק בַּטָּה֑וֹר וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- haz·zāḇ yā·rōq baṭ·ṭā·hō·wr wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: If the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean [that person] must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב עָלָ֛יו אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַזָּ֖ב יִרְכַּ֥ב יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ham·mer·kāḇ ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer haz·zāḇ yir·kaḇ yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Any saddle on which the man with the discharge rides will be unclean

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔יו יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂ֣א אוֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yih·yeh ṯaḥ·tāw yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ wə·han·nō·w·śê ’ō·w·ṯām yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening and whoever carries such things must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: הַזָּ֔ב יִגַּע־ בּוֹ֙ וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־ שָׁטַ֣ף וְיָדָ֖יו בַּמָּ֑יִם וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zāḇ yig·ga‘- bōw wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer lō- šā·ṭap̄ wə·yā·ḏāw bam·mā·yim wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: If the man with the discharge touches anyone - without first rinsing his hands with water the one who was touched must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: חֶ֛רֶשׂ וּכְלִי־ אֲשֶׁר־ הַזָּ֖ב יִגַּע־ בּ֥וֹ יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְכָל־ עֵ֔ץ כְּלִי־ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reś ū·ḵə·lî- ’ă·šer- haz·zāḇ yig·ga‘- bōw yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·ḵāl ‘êṣ kə·lî- yiš·šā·ṭêp̄ bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: Any clay pot that the man with the discharge touches must be broken and any wooden utensil must be rinsed with water

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ הַזָּב֙ יִטְהַ֤ר מִזּוֹב֔וֹ וְסָ֨פַר שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים ל֜וֹ לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו וְרָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ חַיִּ֖ים בְּמַ֥יִם וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- haz·zāḇ yiṭ·har miz·zō·w·ḇōw wə·sā·p̄ar šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm lōw lə·ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bə·śā·rōw ḥay·yîm bə·ma·yim wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: When the man has been cleansed from his discharge he must count off seven days for his cleansing wash his clothes and bathe himself in fresh water and he shall be clean

verses.original: הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י וּבַיּ֣וֹם יִֽקַּֽח־ לוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וּבָ֣א׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּנְתָנָ֖ם אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·mî·nî ū·ḇay·yō·wm yiq·qaḥ- lōw šə·tê ṯō·rîm ’ōw šə·nê bə·nê yō·w·nāh ū·ḇā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·nə·ṯā·nām ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: On the eighth day he is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons come before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and give them to the priest

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִזּוֹבֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·‘ā·śāh ’ō·ṯām ’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘ō·lāh hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw lip̄·nê Yah·weh miz·zō·w·ḇōw
verses.literal: The priest is to sacrifice them one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering In this way the priest will make atonement for [the man] before the LORD because of his discharge

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וְאִ֕ישׁ שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְרָחַ֥ץ כָּל־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־ וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯê·ṣê mim·men·nū wə·’îš šiḵ·ḇaṯ- zā·ra‘ wə·rā·ḥaṣ kāl- bə·śā·rōw bam·ma·yim ’eṯ- wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: When . . . . . . a man has an emission of semen he must bathe his whole body with water - and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְכָל־ בֶּ֣גֶד וְכָל־ ע֔וֹר עָלָ֖יו אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֥ה שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl be·ḡeḏ wə·ḵāl ‘ō·wr ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer- yih·yeh šiḵ·ḇaṯ- zā·ra‘ wə·ḵub·bas bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Any clothing . . . or leather on which there is an emission of semen must be washed with water and it will remain unclean until evening

verses.original: אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ יִשְׁכַּ֥ב וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכְבַת־ זָ֑רַע וְרָחֲצ֣וּ בַמַּ֔יִם וְטָמְא֖וּ עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’ō·ṯāh yiš·kaḇ wə·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer šiḵ·ḇaṯ- zā·ra‘ wə·rā·ḥă·ṣū ḇam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mə·’ū ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: If a man . . . lies with a woman - and there is an emission of semen both must bathe with water and they will remain unclean until evening

verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְאִשָּׁה֙ תִהְיֶ֣ה זֹבָ֖הּ זָבָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֥ה דָּ֛ם בִּבְשָׂרָ֑הּ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְנִדָּתָ֔הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·’iš·šāh ṯih·yeh zō·ḇāh zā·ḇāh yih·yeh dām biḇ·śā·rāh tih·yeh ḇə·nid·dā·ṯāh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·ḵāl han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bāh yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: When a woman has - a discharge consisting of blood from her body she will be unclean due to her menstruation for seven days and anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ עָלָ֛יו אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּשֵׁ֥ב בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer tiš·kaḇ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tê·šêḇ bə·nid·dā·ṯāh yiṭ·mā ‘ā·lāw yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Anything on which she lies - - or sits during her menstruation will be unclean - -

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָ֑הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·miš·kā·ḇāh yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: and anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּכָל־ כְּלִ֖י עָלָ֑יו אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּשֵׁ֣ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·ḵāl kə·lî ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer- tê·šêḇ yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever touches any furniture on which she was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם ה֗וּא עַֽל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב א֧וֹ הַכְּלִ֛י עַֽל־ אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת־ עָלָ֖יו בְּנָגְעוֹ־ ב֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im hū ‘al- ham·miš·kāḇ ’ōw hak·kə·lî ‘al- ’ă·šer- hî yō·še·ḇeṯ- ‘ā·lāw bə·nā·ḡə·‘ōw- ḇōw yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: And whether it is a bed or furniture on which she was sitting . . . whoever touches it will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב נִדָּתָהּ֙ וּתְהִ֤י עָלָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְכָל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ב עָלָ֖יו אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׁכַּ֥ב יִטְמָֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ’îš ’ō·ṯāh šā·ḵōḇ yiš·kaḇ nid·dā·ṯāh ū·ṯə·hî ‘ā·lāw wə·ṭā·mê šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·ḵāl ham·miš·kāḇ ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer- yiš·kaḇ yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: If a man . . . lies with her and her menstrual flow touches him he will be unclean for seven days and any bed on which he lies will become unclean

verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְאִשָּׁ֡ה יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜הּ רַבִּ֗ים יָמִ֣ים עֶת־ בְּלֹא֙ נִדָּתָ֔הּ א֥וֹ כִֽי־ תָז֖וּב עַל־ נִדָּתָ֑הּ הִֽוא׃ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה כָּל־ יְמֵ֞י טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ ז֣וֹב כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·’iš·šāh yā·zūḇ zō·wḇ dā·māh rab·bîm yā·mîm ‘eṯ- bə·lō nid·dā·ṯāh ’ōw ḵî- ṯā·zūḇ ‘al- nid·dā·ṯāh hî tih·yeh ṭə·mê·’āh kāl- yə·mê ṭum·’ā·ṯāh zō·wḇ kî·mê nid·dā·ṯāh
verses.literal: When a woman has a discharge . . . of her blood for many days at a time other than her menstrual period or if it continues beyond her period she will be unclean all the days of her unclean discharge just as she is during the days of her menstruation

verses.original: כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֞ב עָלָיו֙ אֲשֶׁר־ תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב כָּל־ הַכְּלִי֙ עָלָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב יְמֵ֣י זוֹבָ֔הּ יִֽהְיֶה־ נִדָּתָ֖הּ יִהְיֶ֔ה טָמֵ֣א לָּ֑הּ וְכָֽל־ כְּמִשְׁכַּ֥ב כְּטֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·miš·kāḇ ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer- tiš·kaḇ kāl- hak·kə·lî ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer tê·šêḇ yə·mê zō·w·ḇāh yih·yeh- nid·dā·ṯāh yih·yeh ṭā·mê lāh wə·ḵāl kə·miš·kaḇ kə·ṭum·’aṯ nid·dā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Any bed on which she lies or any furniture on which she sits during the days of her discharge - - will be unclean - like her bed during her menstrual period . . .

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנּוֹגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖ם יִטְמָ֑א וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·w·ḡê·a‘ bām yiṭ·mā wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Anyone who touches these things will be unclean he must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening

verses.original: וְאִֽם־ טָהֲרָ֖ה מִזּוֹבָ֑הּ וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ṭā·hă·rāh miz·zō·w·ḇāh wə·sā·p̄ə·rāh lāh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·’a·ḥar tiṭ·hār
verses.literal: When [a woman] is cleansed of her discharge she must count off seven days and after that she will be ceremonially clean

verses.original: הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י וּבַיּ֣וֹם תִּֽקַּֽח־ לָהּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וְהֵבִיאָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·mî·nî ū·ḇay·yō·wm tiq·qaḥ- lāh šə·tê ṯō·rîm ’ōw šə·nê bə·nê yō·w·nāh wə·hê·ḇî·’āh ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- hak·kō·hên ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: On the eighth day she is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ וְעָשָׂ֤ה הָאֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְאֶת־ הָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤יהָ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה טֻמְאָתָֽהּ׃ מִזּ֖וֹב
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·‘ā·śāh hā·’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘ō·lāh hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·le·hā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ṭum·’ā·ṯāh miz·zō·wḇ
verses.literal: The priest - is to sacrifice one as a sin offering - and the other as a burnt offering In this way the priest will make atonement for her before the LORD for her unclean discharge

verses.original: וְהִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִטֻּמְאָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֤א יָמֻ֙תוּ֙ בְּטֻמְאָתָ֔ם בְּטַמְּאָ֥ם אֶת־ מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·zar·tem ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl miṭ·ṭum·’ā·ṯām wə·lō yā·mu·ṯū bə·ṭum·’ā·ṯām bə·ṭam·mə·’ām ’eṯ- miš·kā·nî ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: You must keep - the children of Israel {separate} from their uncleanness so that they do not die . . . by defiling - My tabernacle which is among them

verses.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַזָּ֑ב וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֛נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־ זֶ֖רַע בָֽהּ׃ לְטָמְאָה־
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ haz·zāḇ wa·’ă·šer tê·ṣê mim·men·nū šiḵ·ḇaṯ- ze·ra‘ ḇāh lə·ṭā·mə·’āh-
verses.literal: This is the law of him who has a discharge of the man who has vvv an emission of semen whereby he is unclean

verses.original: וְהַדָּוָה֙ בְּנִדָּתָ֔הּ לַזָּכָ֖ר וְלַנְּקֵבָ֑ה וְהַזָּב֙ אֶת־ זוֹב֔וֹ וּלְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁכַּ֖ב עִם־ טְמֵאָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·had·dā·wāh bə·nid·dā·ṯāh laz·zā·ḵār wə·lan·nə·qê·ḇāh wə·haz·zāḇ ’eṯ- zō·w·ḇōw ū·lə·’îš ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ ‘im- ṭə·mê·’āh
verses.literal: of a woman in her menstrual period of any male or female who has a discharge - - and of a man who lies with an unclean woman
